corpus_scope: Bounded to matching text JSON files at most 500K under outputs/work. Original broker documents, larger files, external computers and other locations are not claimed searched. ICT, broker connections and price/fill archives are excluded.
required_evidence: Dated broker-origin specification or revision evidence identifying the same symbol, server/feed and applicable historical interval.
Precision, minimum price increment, monetary tick value, contract size, profit currency and legal volume increments for each applicable interval.
Any conversion, symbol migration or historical-feed rescaling policy, with effective timestamps and preserved document identity.
A documented bridge from those specifications to the original quote archive, plus separate fee, margin and historical server-clock evidence.
An independently reviewed execution model registered as a new version before any new financial replay; all original benchmarks and failures retained.

references.title: MetaQuotes symbol_info
references.scope: The documented call accepts a symbol name and returns its properties. It has no historical as-of parameter. This does not establish a broker revision timeline.

references.title: MetaQuotes price precision and tick properties
references.scope: Decimal representation, price-change step and monetary tick value are distinct properties. The documentation describes tick values as current; it does not certify this account historical settings.
